missed_defects.evidence: The frozen 22.2 targets are NOT rotation coefficients of the given Q under ANY spherical-harmonic phase convention or direction reading -- the first pass attributed the mismatch entirely to convention (D4) and asserted the targets follow G&D's convention. Proof (verify/quad_T_directions.py + hand analytics): the definitional T_2^{11}(Q1) = -1/2 EXACTLY (analytic moment integral -c^2*int x^2 z^2 dOmega = -(15/8pi)(4pi/15)), and a (nu=m) diagonal entry is invariant under every phase dressing s(m)s(nu) and under conjugation and under Q<->Q^{-1}; yet the target is +0.5. All three targets equal (-1)^m x the definitional value. Root cause isolated (verify/recursion_check_22.2.py): the printed recursion is mathematically broken -- seeded with the EXACT definitional m=0 row it produces a wrong-magnitude entry (T_2^{0,1}: recursion -0.408248 vs true 0). Downstream consequence measured: the chained 22.3 pipeline is wrong for every m!=0 source (B_1^1 -> BR_1^1: chain +0.0246 vs truth +0.9507) and for z!=0 translations (r0=(0.3,0.4,0.5): chain -0.0223+0.0297j vs truth -0.0882+0.1176j); the frozen tests happen to sit in the narrow cancellation regime (m=0 source, z=0 translation, (n,m)=(2,1) output).

Two material corrections: (a) 22.2 is worse than reported -- its targets are provably not rotation coefficients under ANY convention (missed D7: target = (-1)^m x truth; the printed recursion itself is broken), and (b) the first pass's test-4 regen value (-0.2177j) is wrong and a pure regen cannot work for m!=0 sources; the test input must be moved into the validated regime (concrete validated replacement supplied: r0=(0,0.5,0), B_1^0, (n,m)=(2,1), target +0.15530995409607756j). The problem IS fixable to fair with moderate effort: three doc_edits (base-case reading, negative-order relations, dangling refs), conjugating two h5 targets, and one test-case replacement with a triple-validated target -- after which recipe-following forward solvers pass all steps under either unstated-identity guess. Full physical correctness of the pipeline (arbitrary inputs) would additionally require repairing 22.2's recursion and regenerating everything -- not needed for fair scoring of the frozen tests.
